title: 循环队列
full_code:
class CircularQueue:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.data = [None] * capacity
        self.head = 0
        self.count = 0

    def enqueue(self, v):
        if self.count == len(self.data):
            return False
        self.data[(self.head + self.count) % len(self.data)] = v
        self.count += 1
        return True

    def dequeue(self):
        if self.count == 0:
            return None
        v = self.data[self.head]
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % len(self.data)
        self.count -= 1
        return v

q = CircularQueue(3)
for v in (1, 2, 3):
    q.enqueue(v)
print("满后入队:", q.enqueue(4))
print(q.dequeue(), q.dequeue())
q.enqueue(5)
print("剩余:", [q.dequeue() for _ in range(2)])
expected:
满后入队: False
1 2
剩余: [3, 5]

💡 下标都对容量取模实现环绕

title: 两个队列实现栈
description: 每次把新元素排到最前
full_code:
from collections import deque

class StackByQueues:
    def __init__(self):
        self.q1 = deque()
        self.q2 = deque()

    def push(self, v):
        self.q2.append(v)
        while self.q1:
            self.q2.append(self.q1.popleft())
        self.q1, self.q2 = self.q2, self.q1

    def pop(self):
        return self.q1.popleft() if self.q1 else None

s = StackByQueues()
s.push(1)
s.push(2)
s.push(3)
print(s.pop(), s.pop(), s.pop())

points.hint: 💡 新元素先进 q2
💡 把 q1 的旧元素接在后面再交换

hints.level_2: 📖 栈 LIFO 后进先出，队列 FIFO 先进先出；单调栈/单调队列维护有序性
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`while self.q1:`、`self.q1, self.q2 = self.q2, self.q1`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`while self.q1:`；`self.q1, self.q2 = self.q2, self.q1`

explanation: 用队列模拟栈的代价在 push：每次把新元素顶到队首。与两栈成队（代价在 pop）互为镜像。
